name: Tunis
tagline: Medina, mosaics, Carthage and blue-and-white Sidi Bou Said
summary: Tunis combines a UNESCO medina, the world's greatest Roman mosaic collection at the Bardo, and the ruins of Carthage on the coast. Wander the souks to the Zitouna Mosque, see Carthage's Antonine Baths, and sip pine-nut mint tea in blue-and-white Sidi Bou Said.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are ideal; summer is hot; winter is mild and rainy.
arrival: Tunis-Carthage Airport is 15 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: TGM light rail links the centre to Carthage and Sidi Bou Said; taxis are cheap.
cashTip: Dinars can't be taken out of the country; change what you need and carry cash for taxis, medina shops and cafés.
foodTip: Brik, couscous, lablabi and pine-nut tea.
buyTip: Ceramics, chechia hats and olive wood in the souks.
baseArea: Medina, Ville Nouvelle or Sidi Bou Said
